info.name: Nextcloud Access Audit
info.summary: Audit user group memberships and active file shares in Nextcloud.
info.description:
Nextcloud Access Audit provides authorized users with a centralized view of user group memberships and active file and folder shares.
The application helps identify users, authentication backends, group memberships, internal shares, public links and other active sharing permissions configured within the Nextcloud instance.
It is designed as a read-only auditing and reporting tool whose access can be restricted to selected groups through Nextcloud application settings.
info.author: Benjamin AIMARD
